mapper.sql: id, title, description, creator_id, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_questionnaire (title, description, creator_id, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{creatorId}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
